# 9. Recon: details
## Inputs
- **Sheet** and **Adjacent Table**: typed labels in the Recon table. - **Spilled row lists**: Sunday to Friday A3, Daily Supply & Demand A8 and A287, DoughWeights A4, Mix-Slice-Oven A6 and A410. - **Adjacent tables**: Sunday to Friday, `DSD_DSnD`, `Dist_DSnD`, DoughWeight, `Mix_Slice`, `Oven_Info`.
## Formula reference
- **Array Cell**: `=SUBSTITUTE(MID(FORMULATEXT([@[Array Rows]]),FIND("!",FORMULATEXT([@[Array Rows]]))+1,99),")","")` - **Array Rows**: `=ROWS(ANCHORARRAY(Sunday!A3))` (Sunday row; each row names its own spill) - **Table Rows**: `=ROWS(Sunday[])` (Sunday row; each row names its own table) - **Difference (Array − Table)**: `=[@[Array Rows]]-[@[Table Rows]]` - **Status**: `=IF([@[Array Rows]]=[@[Table Rows]],"Match",IF([@[Table Rows]]>[@[Array Rows]],"Table longer","Array longer"))` - **As stored in the file** (A1 style, same result): Array Cell `=SUBSTITUTE(MID(FORMULATEXT(C5),FIND("!",FORMULATEXT(C5))+1,99),")","")`; Difference `=C5-E5`; Status `=IF(C5=E5,"Match",IF(E5>C5,"Table longer","Array longer"))`
## Worked example
- **DoughWeight**: Array Rows 453 (DoughWeights A4#), Table Rows 452, Difference 1, Status Array longer: the last SKU, F2562, gets no formulas. - **Wednesday**: Array Rows 395, Table Rows 447, Difference -52, Status Table longer: 52 rows of N/A under the list. - **Mix_Slice**: Array Rows 390, Table Rows 391, Difference -1, Status Table longer. - **Sunday, Monday, DSD_DSnD, Dist_DSnD**: Status Match.
## Open questions
- Should Recon also count N/A errors inside each table? - Should any status other than Match turn a header red so it is seen before printing? - Should Recon compare Sunday!B1 with the anchor date and K4 with today's day?
